faq_heading: Homes near Latimer Road Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Latimer Road Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Latimer Road Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active houses, townhomes and condos whose listing description names Latimer Road Elementary. MLS® listings are not tagged by school, so a nearby home whose listing does not name the school will not show, and a listing that does can be farther than 1 km away.
